```yaml
name: Token Usage Dashboard

on:
  workflow_run:
    workflows: ["evaluation"]
    types:
      - completed

jobs:
  collect:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          ref: token-dashboard
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Ensure token-dashboard branch exists
        run: |
          git fetch origin token-dashboard || git checkout -b token-dashboard
          git checkout token-dashboard

      - name: Download token metrics artifact
        uses: dawidd6/action-download-artifact@v11
        with:
          github_token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          workflow: evaluation
          run_id: ${{ github.event.workflow_run.id }}
          name: token-usage
          path: artifacts

      - name: Aggregate token data
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          $artifactPath = "./artifacts/token-usage.json"
          $outputPath  = "./dashboard/data/aggregated.json"
          if (!(Test-Path "./dashboard/data")) { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path "./dashboard/data" }
          # Run the PowerShell aggregation script
          ./scripts/generate-token-data.ps1 -InputPath $artifactPath -OutputPath $outputPath

      - name: Commit and push aggregated data
        run: |
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git add ./dashboard/data/aggregated.json
          git commit -m "Update token usage data $(date -u +"%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ")" || echo "No changes to commit"
          git push origin token-dashboard

      - name: Configure GitHub Pages
        uses: actions/configure-pages@v2
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Upload dashboard artifact
        uses: actions/upload-pages-artifact@v1
        with:
          path: ./dashboard

      - name: Deploy to GitHub Pages
        uses: actions/deploy-pages@v1
```
